purpose: Label-free offline feature preprocessing for the 6,690 SLURP DEVEL-REMAINDER devel recordings (owner decision 107 of 2026-09-23: the development side may expand up to the full SLURP devel split, prepared with the same pipeline as DEV-2000-ADDED, built ahead of time and in parallel). The roster receipt is docs/receipts/rosters/slurp-devel-remainder-v1.json and the runtime view is configs/dataset/slurp-speech-native-devel-remainder.json. A model-free audit (docs/checks/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/2026-09-23-slurp-devel-remainder-packets/media-inventory.json) measured 60 of 6,690 rows warm in the legacy feature cache slurp-q4km (exactly the historic probe-60) and 0 of 6,690 already promoted under the resident packet root, so this run contacts every roster row exactly once and never re-touches the already-promoted DEV-100 / DEV-500 / DEV-1000 / DEV-2000-ADDED packets. It runs on the -np 8 sidecar fragment, whose feature equivalence with the -np 4 geometry every sealed packet was produced with is proven first by the 4-row preflight SAEA-SN-DEVEL-REMAINDER-NP8-EQUIVALENCE-4-V1. Keep the resident decoder-only inference service on port 8080 untouched, populate only the legacy speech feature cache through a separate CPU-only sidecar on port 8081, and never inspect generated text, labels, reference transcripts, or task accuracy. The fixed one-token response is never read semantically. Precedent: SAEA-SN-DEV2000-ADDED-PREPROCESS (2026-09-21, configs/experiment/slurp-dev2000-added-preprocess.json), itself following SAEA-SN-DEV1000-PREPROCESS (2026-08-24).
